name: anatoliyaksenov-airflow-etl-pipeline-generator
description: Integrates with Apache Airflow, GitLab, Kafka, PostgreSQL, S3, and SMB file systems to enable conversational ETL pipeline creation, data source connectivity testing, schema extraction, and automatic generation of production-ready Airflow DAGs with pre-built Spark application templates for database-to-datalake, file-to-datalake, and API-to-datalake workflows.
